# SI2 Def 

This library contains code adapted from [Si2 DEF](https://github.com/The-OpenROAD-Project-Attic/def.git).


## Changes

- Some files depend on def.tab.h generated by Bison, but in reality Bison outputs def.tab.hpp. Therefore, the two #include "def.tab.h" directives were changed to #include "def.tab.hpp".
